713:t_012:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Of course. This $$次元将$$ is the ultimate union of human and machine achieved with $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$.」

713:t_012:3.en:
$$レド$$
「So it is the ultimate form of artificial $$真化融合$$...!」

713:t_012:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is correct. Unless you stake everything, you cannot possibly fight me on equal terms.」

713:t_012:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is time to end this! Farewell, warriors who gave me even a momentary glimpse of an unattainable dream!」

713:t_013:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's the presence I felt before in $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

713:t_013:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Then that's the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow!」

713:t_013:5.en:
???
「The $$次元将$$ is not the only sorrowful one...」

713:t_013:9.en:
???
「Those who cannot abandon conflict and destroy themselves... They are all sorrowful...」

713:t_013:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even so... we decided to move forward!」

713:t_013:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Humans may be foolish creatures who cannot stop fighting...」

713:t_013:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「But there are things we can never obtain unless we overcome that...!」

713:t_013:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is why we fight...! No, why we live!」

713:t_013:15.en:
$$葵$$
「Living...! It's the instinct that starts everything!」

713:t_013:16.en:
$$アマタ$$
「As we live, we meet... and connect!」

713:t_013:17.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then we set out in search of something we have yet to see!」

713:t_013:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And we build civilization, seeking a future beyond battle!」

713:t_013:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire...」

713:t_013:21.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though despair halted them once, they once again follow the path to $$シンカ$$, step by step! What awaits them is...」

713:t_014:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Time, which had stopped, has begun moving again...」

713:t_014:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Yes... it is moving toward the future!」

713:t_015:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Save it for later, $$セツコ$$! We must deal with $$ヴィルダーク$$ right in front of us first!」

713:t_015:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You have regained the power of $$真化融合$$...」

713:t_015:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「I've kept you waiting, $$マジンガー$$! Let's unite our light again!」

713:t_015:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$! Now is the time for the possibility you guided me toward!」

713:t_015:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this, $$ダイ・ガード$$! A salaryman and a robot will protect peace together!」

713:t_015:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's more like it!」

713:t_016:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warriors need victory, not pity!」

713:t_016:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warriors who achieved $$真化融合$$! Fighting you and winning was my wish as well!」

713:t_016:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「By defeating you, I will repay every life I took to turn into a $$次元獣$$!」

713:t_016:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I knew that our methods were wrong.」

713:t_016:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$次元獣ヴァルナー$$ has not reached its final form... That must be proof of my hesitation.」

713:t_016:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I had no choice... I kept believing there was no other way. But it was all meaningless.」

713:t_016:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「All I can do is defeat you with this power, to repay their lives...!」

713:t_016:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can't bear to watch a man lose sight of his duty in his own self-satisfaction.」

713:t_016:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you knew what you were doing was wrong, why wouldn't you try to change yourself?!」

713:t_016:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't refuse to change if there is a better way!」

713:t_016:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your greatest mistake is your arrogance, refusing to change the way you live!」

713:t_016:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you will. This is all I can do.」

713:t_016:17.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then I'll take you on! The way you want it!」

713:t_016:18.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We can't afford to lose either!」

713:t_016:19.en:
$n
「Just as you cannot accept our existence, we cannot accept you after all the suffering you've caused Earth!」

713:t_016:20.en:
$n
「I will never accept a future forged with power like that!」

713:t_016:21.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come, warriors of Earth! The victor will earn the right to challenge the $$御使い$$!」

713:t_016:22.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will devour you, take your four $$スフィア$$s, and obtain god-killing power!」

713:t_017:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is this... as far as I go...?!」

713:t_017:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The fight's over, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

713:t_017:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You need not tell me... You are the victors...」

713:t_018:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Forgive me, $$次元獣$$s... I have no strength left to fight...」

713:t_019:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... could not repay the lives I took...」

713:t_019:2.en:
$n
「Repaying them matters... But if you call yourself a general, you should have sought something you could do for the living.」

713:t_019:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you reached, beyond both hope and despair...?」

713:t_019:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it is an answer...」

713:t_019:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$揺れる天秤$$...」

713:t_019:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Any of you will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You achieved $$真化融合$$, so you should be able to.」

713:t_019:7.en:
$n
「...I can't do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

713:t_019:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've known the $$次元将$$ since the $$破界事変$$. This should be my job.」

713:t_019:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$... I thank you for your strong resolve.」

713:t_019:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stop it. I don't need thanks from someone whose life I'm about to take.」
